title: NoAITell Terms of Use | NoAITell
description: Read the terms for NoAITell’s local text cleaning and writing-pattern review tool.
body:
Effective November 4, 2026. NoAITell provides local text inspection and selected formatting cleanup. You are responsible for the material you process, your right to use it, and the accuracy of anything you publish. Follow applicable attribution and disclosure requirements.

Findings are editing suggestions based on current rules. They are not proof of AI generation, human authorship, or the presence or absence of a vendor watermark. Statistical watermark verification and heavy rewriting are not features of this release.

Review all changes before relying on a result. Keep an original copy of important documents. Punctuation, spaces and joiners may have context-specific meanings, especially in code, quotations and multilingual writing.

Free cleaning is limited to 3 uses per local day per browser device and 500 words per use. The browser counter is a convenience restriction, not an account entitlement. Availability and rule coverage may change.

The tool is supplied as available without a guarantee of uninterrupted service or suitability for a particular purpose, to the extent permitted by law. These terms do not exclude rights that cannot legally be excluded. Pro plans are previews only; notification requests do not create a purchase or subscription.

Contact: noaitell@knowhy.net.
